s0: ^Town Guard: Hail the king. Hail Cecily Town. Hail Slepbone. Hail my cousin. Hail my cousin’s sister. Hail my sister’s cousin’s sister.
s1: ^Town Guard: I tell the chef his lamb shoulder is still not perfect. He’s a perfectionist, which means the longer I lie to him, the more lamb I get to taste.
s2: ^Town Guard: Ah... castle life. Roam the halls, keep the boots polished, sip wine here and there, bow to the king... I’m living the dream.
s3: ^Town Guard: The general used to train us to fight with sand in our eyes. Now? Most lads complain if the stew’s got too much salt.
s4: ^Town Guard: A soldier’s best friend is his shield. Second best friend? The tavern stool after a long shift.
s5: ^Town Guard: This armor? Heavy as sin. But it keeps the wine in my belly from sloshing too loud when I walk.
s6: ^Town Guard: My cousin swears he once arm-wrestled a giant. Won’t stop bragging. He leaves out the part where the giant was only two years old.
